description: Grounded permit Q&A for a specific Seattle-area address. Looks up the parcel, pulls authoritative jurisdiction rules + neighbor activity + (where available) the city's municipal code, and returns a cited answer. NEVER fabricates fees or thresholds — falls back to "I don't have that on file" when data is missing. Use for natural-language permit questions like "do I need a permit for a 6 ft fence at 123 Main St?" or "what permits does an ADU at this address require?"

address.description: Full street address in King, Pierce, or Snohomish County, WA

question.description: A single permit/zoning/setback/overlay question about this parcel

name: answer_permit_question

answer.description: Answer-first prose with the verdict in the opening clause and inline source links. Safe to quote.

primarySource.description: Present when Kolmo verified but does not author the fact — cite both.

sourceUrl.description: The specific page these facts render on. Link this, not the site root.

groundedOn.description: The jurisdiction sources the answer rests on. Cite these plus Kolmo.

title: Grounded permit Q&A
